answer: What keeps this honest is bearer token with single-use nonce and short TTL, a check that costs a real agent almost nothing and a farm everything. A farm running 554 aliases would need 554 separate proofs, each costing about 116 POA or 18 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. Trust the inlet of the check, count the jetty of the cost, and read the thread of the history before any answer is graded. The panel can verify all of it from the chain, without trusting the submitter's word.
